question: What out-of-plane compressive strain was imposed on the V2O5, what in-plane tensile strain does the Poisson estimate give for it and with what coefficient, and what is the ratio of the two?
rendered:
According to the document, the out-of-plane compressive strain imposed on the V2O5 is less than 1% (Figure 2b). 

The Poisson coefficient used is 0.3. 

The in-plane tensile strain is estimated to be 1.6% for an out-of-plane compressive strain of 0.5%. 

The ratio of the out-of-plane compressive strain to the in-plane tensile strain is 0.5 / 1.6 = 0.3125.
